title: Maryland PSC Order No. 92505 (Case No. 9795)
text:
COMMISSIONERS 

KUMAR P. BARVE

S T A T E O F M A R Y L A N D 

PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION 

July 7, 2026 

Application of Wicomico Rayne Solar, LLC for 
a Certificate of Public Convenience and 
Necessity to construct a 5 MW solar 
photovoltaic generating facility in Wicomico 
County, Maryland 
* 

* 

* 

Case No. 9795 

VIA EMAIL 

To All Parties of Record and Interested Persons: 

The Proposed Order of Public Utility Law Judge filed in the above-entitled matter 
on June 4, 2026, was not appealed by any party, nor has the Commission modified or 
reversed the Proposed Order or initiated further proceedings into this matter. Accordingly, 
today the Proposed Order became a final order of the Commission, and it was entered on the 
docket of the Commission as Order No. 92505. 

Very truly yours, 

/s/ Kathleen Berends 

Kathleen Berends 

Administrator
